title: CFG-01 Select versioned LLM profiles
statement: The application SHALL configure provider, model, API base URL, wire format, reasoning mode, supported sampling settings, secret environment reference and role-to-profile bindings through operator-controlled versioned profiles. docs/llm-configuration.md SHALL define the DeepSeek 4.1 fast development profile requested by the user while preserving the original OpenAI baseline. No client-provided endpoint, silent fallback or automatic Codex configuration mutation is permitted.
source: Recovered v6 or explicit current-user full-source/configurable-LLM specification addition; planned only.

title: CFG-02 Qualify strict output and failures
statement: A configured LLM SHALL qualify each full original closed schema and prompt contract before use. JSON syntax alone is insufficient. Unsupported schema keywords or transport formats SHALL fail qualification without deleting constraints; extra fields, fabricated spans, wrong-subject references, truncation, refusal and malformed output SHALL fail server checks or become the specified review/failure state. LLM output SHALL never create numerical grades, observed acoustics or human approvals.
source: Recovered v6 or explicit current-user full-source/configurable-LLM specification addition; planned only.

title: CFG-03 Freeze provider provenance and caches
statement: Attempts SHALL freeze profile/model/requested and returned model metadata, endpoint, prompt and schema hashes, reasoning/supported settings, input/case/answer hashes and versions. Exact matching stage results alone are reusable. Profile changes or moving-alias drift SHALL invalidate affected calibration/cache evidence and require qualification and applicable held-out evaluation before production acceptance. Development-profile selection is authorized by the current user; it does not prove empirical equivalence or approve speech-provider substitutions.
source: Recovered v6 or explicit current-user full-source/configurable-LLM specification addition; planned only.

title: CFG-04 Keep credentials server private
statement: LLM secrets SHALL resolve from a server-only environment reference. Codex configuration is read-only discovery evidence, not application runtime configuration. Secret values/full config/auth stores SHALL NOT be copied into the repository, image, browser, prompt or logs. Cloud disclosure acknowledgment and source-use permission SHALL precede external transfer; identity/consent material SHALL not be sent to the model.
source: Recovered v6 or explicit current-user full-source/configurable-LLM specification addition; planned only.

title: SYNC-01 Preserve deadline lease and request identity
statement: Attempts SHALL persist original UTF-8/hash and idempotency atomically before providers, permit empty answers, and reject over 20,000 Unicode codepoints. Same key/different payload SHALL return 409. Revision/token compare-and-swap SHALL enforce a 300-second lease; stale returns cannot commit and network calls cannot hold a DB transaction. A single propagated 270-second attempt deadline SHALL cover extraction 40, mapping 70, audit 70, feedback 40 and at least five seconds for persistence. API write/proxy/browser timeouts SHALL be 285/300/310 seconds. At most one transport retry per request budget is permitted, with no JSON repair loop or background recovery.
source: Recovered v6 or explicit current-user full-source/configurable-LLM specification addition; planned only.

title: SYNC-02 Distinguish lifecycle statuses
statement: The stored attempt state SHALL follow the recovered lifecycle: draft -> submitted -> evaluating -> complete, review_required or evaluation_failed. The API SHALL return 200 for complete/review_required, 409 EVALUATION_IN_PROGRESS for an active lease, 502 for refusal/schema failure and 504 for deadline. UI labels ready/needs_review/technical_error SHALL be explicitly derived from those states and never replace contract enums. Quarantine/disputes SHALL preserve immutable saved answers and append result revisions.
source: Recovered v6 or explicit current-user full-source/configurable-LLM specification addition; planned only.

title: VALFULL-01 Preserve every validation gate
statement: Release SHALL satisfy every recovered VAL-STRUCT/MAP/COVER/REPAIR/REPEAT/AUDIO/SCORE/ISOLATION gate in domain/validation-policy.yaml for fixed versions. Precision SHALL be >=0.98 overall and >=0.95 per observable domain with >=100 human-labelled eligible mappings/domain; coverage >=0.90 overall and per domain; correction agreement >=0.95 on >=100 attempts/domain with every critical counterexample correct; repeat mapping agreement >=0.99 over three identical fixed holdout runs. All 122 leaves/control types and exact rational metrics SHALL remain in scope. Thresholds/weights remain inherited policy candidates under DEC-008, with no sample-deficient PASS.
